observations: body: the line numbers 5 to 45 stand in the right margin and the locators «p. 202.» (L17) and «p. 203.» (L44) in the left margin. In the line numbers 15 and 35 the 5 is printed broken, like 3. The page has no notes.

body L18: Nallino's addenda et emendanda (Part I, p. LXXII) read «134,18, post consistit haec inserantur: [distantiam multiplica in tempora horaria gradus sequentis]. Cfr. p. 316, adn. 3.»; the line is kept as printed.
body L46: Nallino's addenda et emendanda (Part I, p. LXXII) read «134,ult.: Verba hoc modo hilegia etc., fortasse spuria; cfr. praefationem p. XLIII.»; the words are kept as printed.
body L46: the letter of the reference (b) is bold italic; it is printed broken, its bowl open.
body L21, L30: short strokes slanting like an acute accent stand over the a before «paxillo» (L21) and over the a of «rectarum» (L30); Latin has no accent here, and they are not read as accents.
body L5, L44: specks stand over the s of «illius» (L5) and under the e and the s of «quantitates» (L44); they are not accents.
body L3: a blot hangs under the s and the p of «hemisphaerio»; it is not a sign.
body L12: the r of «maiora» before the dash is printed with a speck over it; it is not an accent.
body L17: the s of «est» is printed broken, like 8, and the i of «in» after it is printed blotted, joined to the n.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
